subject: Air freight quote – MEL
body:
Hi,

Could you quote your fastest air freight option to MEL (Melbourne, AU), including trucking from our site in 73488 (Esslingen), Germany, to the airport?

The shipment is 1 piece of machine parts, 1615 kg gross and 7.93 cbm, ready for pickup on 2026-11-24. Please send the all-in price in EUR and the earliest arrival you can offer.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio
